answer: By the anchor of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Work waits on the velvet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the garden of the next round. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, clawed back after a replayed submission, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
